chift_routes.one_line: Workaround (D11): native endpoint, but EUR-only and numeric operation numbers only. Maps to POST /book-entries.miscellaneous-operations.new, which posts an OD into a daybook of Type 600, the only type auto-selected and validated (D6). Each signed Chift amount is split into Debit/Credit and the line type becomes Type 1/2/3. Extra calls: per-folder daybook and analytics caches (D8), a fiscal-years.list + book-entries.list Filter.DocumentNo duplicate pre-check whenever operation_number is supplied (D12), and a GET /book-entries.info read-back (Folder.Id checked, D13) when Horus generates the number. line_number is not stored (array order only), and 'posted' entries (Confirmed=true unless the per-consumer 'always push unconfirmed' setting is on) cannot be deleted through the API.

summary: Chift 'Create miscellaneous operation' maps onto the dedicated Horus POST /book-entries.miscellaneous-operations.new ("Insert a miscellaneous operation (OD). The result will contain the generated book entry's id."), posted as application/json into a daybook of Type 600 (MiscOperation), the only daybook type this route auto-selects or accepts (D6). The payload needs only deterministic transformations: each signed Chift amount becomes the non-negative Debit/Credit columns (positive = Credit), the line type becomes Type 1/2/3, partner_id becomes CompanyId on customer/supplier lines, status becomes Confirmed (posted → true unless the per-consumer 'always push unconfirmed' setting is on, D12) plus AutoGenerateNumber when a confirmed operation has no number, the date gets a time and offset, and analytic_account (a cost-section GUID) becomes one CostLine whose schema and section search keys come from the per-folder analytics cache (D8). The call pattern is: resolve the folder (D7) and the cached reference data (daybooks.list; cost-schemas.list + cost-sections.list with IncludeInactive=true; optional accounts/companies checks with Folder.Id guards, D13); when operation_number is supplied, get the fiscal-year period from fiscal-years.list and run a book-entries.list Filter.DocumentNo duplicate pre-check (D12); post; then, only when Horus generated the number or the stored state must be confirmed, read back with GET /book-entries.info?Id= and check its Folder.Id (D13). The verdict is workaround under D11: non-EUR operations (no currency field) and non-numeric operation numbers cannot be posted, line_number is not stored, and extra per-request calls are needed. Other risks: Horus refuses unbalanced ODs and has no AllowUnbalanced option on this endpoint, Chift's default 'posted' sets Confirmed=true which removes the API delete option, updates create a new book-entry Id, and there is no idempotency key, so a timeout must be followed by a duplicate check and never by a blind retry.
verdict_rationale:
Supported with workaround, under the D11 calibration. Horus has a native write endpoint built for this business object: an OD in a MiscOperation daybook, Type 600 (Guide: Data model table "Miscellaneous operation 600 book-entries.miscellaneous-operations.new"), and every required Chift field maps with a deterministic transformation: amount sign → Debit/Credit, type enum → Type, date → date-time, status → Confirmed.

It is not 'supported', because D11 reserves that verdict for routes where nothing is emulated and only minor optional fields are lost. This route misses that bar on four counts:
- Currency: the misc-op schema has no CurrencyCode/CurrencyRate (D: unlike the invoice endpoints), so non-EUR operations cannot be posted at all and are rejected. For a client with multi-currency ODs, the route behaves as not_supported for those operations, and this must be stated explicitly to clients.
- Numbering: Horus Number is numeric ("Number *: number"), so alphanumeric operation_number values are refused and leading zeros are lost.
- line_number: there is no writable line-number field. Only the array order is conveyed (A: assumed stored as OrderNo), so the Chift value itself is dropped.
- Extra per-request calls: create returns only an Id, so a GET /book-entries.info read-back is needed when Horus generates the number. D12 also adds a fiscal-years.list + book-entries.list (Filter.DocumentNo) duplicate pre-check whenever operation_number is supplied.

The reference lookups (daybooks, cost schemas and sections, D8) are cached per folder and would not justify the downgrade on their own. partner_id on a general_account line is dropped too, but it has no accounting meaning there (Guide: CompanyId "Not used" for Type 3).

horus_endpoints.role: Called with Filter.Dates=[operation_date] and Filter.IncludeFuture=true, for two uses. (b) Optional closed-period pre-check: a fiscal year should contain operation_date, and the date should fall strictly after LastMiscOperationsClosureDate. The comparison rule is a deduction (D), and the field is an untyped string|null, so it must be parsed defensively. The connector can then refuse or warn cleanly instead of relying on an undocumented Horus error.

call_sequence: 0. [CHIFT_INTERNAL] Map consumer_id to the Horus licence connection: licence-specific api_url plus Bearer token, refreshed once on 401. Resolve FolderId with the shared folder rule (D7): use query folder_id when given; if it is null and exactly one folder was selected at activation, use that folder; if no selection is stored, use the single folder returned by POST /folders.list {Mode: 0} (cached); otherwise return 400 'folder_id required'. Any Horus 403 is returned as Chift 400 'folder not accessible with this connection' (D7).

1. [Connector validation, no Horus call] Reject the request before calling Horus when any of these holds: currency != 'EUR', or currency_exchange_rate is neither null nor 1; lines is empty; a customer_account/supplier_account line has no partner_id; operation_number is present but not purely numeric, or does not round-trip after conversion (leading zeros, more than 15 digits); the lines do not balance (round each amount to 2 decimals and require sum(amount) == 0).

2. [Journal] If journal_id is given: validate it against the cached daybooks.list, or GET /daybooks.info?Id=journal_id, and require Data.Folder.Id == FolderId (D13, otherwise 400) and Type == 600 (MiscOperation, D6). Daybooks of Type 610/690/700 are listed by Get journals as miscellaneous_operation with blocked=true (A), so they are rejected with 400 too. If journal_id is null: POST /daybooks.list {FolderId, Filter:{Types:[600]}}. Exactly one result → that is the DaybookId; otherwise return an error. Chift rule: 'automatically set if only one journal exists otherwise an error will be thrown'. This matches Get journals, where Type 600 is the only non-blocked miscellaneous_operation type (D6).

3. [Analytics, only if a line has analytic_account] GET /folders.info (cached) → WithAnalytics must be true. Resolve each analytic_account (a Horus cost-section GUID Id, D8) only from the per-folder analytics cache: POST /cost-schemas.list once per folder, plus POST /cost-sections.list per List-type (CostSectionType 100) schema with Filter.IncludeInactive=true. Make no per-call cost-sections.info / cost-schemas.info lookups (D8). An id that is not in the cache (unknown, a section of another folder, or anything outside a List-type schema) → 400; a section with Inactive=true → 422 (D8). Keep the section SearchKey (Value), the parent schema SearchKey (SchemaSearchKey) and the folder's Mandatory schemas.

4. [Fiscal year and optional pre-checks]
- Fiscal year: POST /fiscal-years.list {FolderId, Filter:{Dates:[operation_date as ISO 8601], IncludeFuture:true}}. Required when operation_number is supplied, because step 5 needs the fiscal-year period (StartDate/EndDate → StartMonth/StartYear/EndMonth/EndYear) (D12); otherwise optional. Refuse or warn only if no fiscal year comes back even with IncludeFuture=true; Horus's own behaviour in that case is undocumented ('?'). Require operation_date strictly after LastMiscOperationsClosureDate (D); that field is an untyped string|null, so parse it defensively. GET /fiscal-years.info returns IsClosed.
- Accounts: POST /accounts.list {FolderId, Filter:{SearchKeys:[distinct account_numbers]}}. The filter is starts-with, so require an exact SearchKey match. Flag Inactive and IsSummary accounts; whether Horus refuses them is '?'.
- Partners: for each distinct partner_id, POST /companies.list {FolderId, Filter:{Id}} (folder-scoped by FolderId). If GET /companies.info is used instead, require Data.Folder.Id == FolderId, otherwise 400 (D13). Check that the company exists and is IsCustomer (Type 1) or IsSupplier (Type 2). Optionally compare account_number with the company's Customer/SupplierConcentrationAccount, resolved to a SearchKey ('?').

5. [Duplicate pre-check, D12: whenever operation_number is supplied, drafts included] POST /book-entries.list {FolderId, DaybookId, StartMonth/StartYear/EndMonth/EndYear = fiscal year from step 4, Filter:{DocumentNo: Number}}. Compare DocumentNo exactly on the client side. A match → reject with 400 'operation_number already exists in this journal and fiscal year' (with the existing book entry Id in the message) and do not create. Treating daybook + fiscal year as the uniqueness scope of Number is an assumption (A): Horus does not document Number uniqueness.

6. [Build payload] Sort lines by line_number (stable sort). For each line:
- Type from type.
- Account = account_number.
- amount > 0 → Credit = amount, Debit = 0; amount < 0 → Debit = -amount, Credit = 0.
- Comment = description.
- CompanyId = partner_id, only for Type 1/2.
- If analytic_account: CostLines = [{Amount: |amount|, Costs: [{SchemaSearchKey, Value: section SearchKey}]}], both keys from the D8 cache. A single cost line carries 100% of the line, so the D8 largest-remainder rounding rule is trivially exact.
Header: FolderId, DaybookId, Date = operation_date + 'T00:00:00+00:00'.
Status and number cases (D12):
- draft → Confirmed=false, Number = operation_number or 0.
- posted with the per-consumer setting 'always push unconfirmed' on → Confirmed=false, Number = operation_number or 0. AutoGenerateNumber is not sent (it "Only works if "Confirmed" is set to *true*"), and the response status is 'draft'.
- posted with a number → Confirmed=true, Number = operation_number.
- posted without a number → Confirmed=true, AutoGenerateNumber=true, Number=0.
7. Record timestamp T0 just before the call, with a safety margin for clock skew. Then POST /book-entries.miscellaneous-operations.new (Content-Type: application/json) → {Id}.

8. [Read-back, conditional: AutoGenerateNumber was used, or the response must reflect what Horus stored] GET /book-entries.info?Id=Id: one call, no FolderId, DaybookId or period. Accept it only if Data.Folder.Id == FolderId and Data.Daybook.Id == DaybookId (D13); otherwise return 400 (not expected for an Id this call has just created in that folder). Take DocumentNo, Confirmed, Date, Daybook.Id and the AccountHistories[] references.
Only if full line fidelity is wanted (book-entries.info returns line references only and is not a sideloading endpoint): POST /account-histories.list {FolderId, StartMonth/StartYear/EndMonth/EndYear = month of operation_date, Filter:{BookEntryId: Id, IncludeReport:false, IncludeCompanyDetail:true, IncludeCostDetail:true}} → OrderNo, AccountSearchKey, Debit, Credit, Comment, AccountType, CompanyDetail.Company.Id and CostDetail. Compare the returned Ids with the AccountHistories references (D; whether that array includes IsReport lines is '?').
If lines are missing: GET /account-histories.info?Id=<one reference> → AccountingMonth/AccountingYear, then repeat account-histories.list with that exact period, or resolve each missing reference with account-histories.info (1 call per line). account-histories.info has no Folder field: call it only on references from the verified book-entries.info and check Data.BookEntry.Id == Id (D13).

9. Build MiscellaneousOperationOut: id = Id; journal_id = the DaybookId used (equal to Daybook.Id when read back); status from the Confirmed value actually sent (so 'draft' when 'always push unconfirmed' forced it, D12), or from book-entries.info when read back; operation_number = Number, or DocumentNo from book-entries.info, as a string (null if 0); operation_date = request date (or book-entries.info Date as YYYY-MM-DD); currency = 'EUR'; currency_exchange_rate = 1; lines echoed from the request, or rebuilt from the line read-back.
Error mapping (map on Horus ErrorType, the machine-readable category, not on Message):
- 400 → Chift 400/422 with Horus Details; do not retry.
- 401 → refresh the token once and retry; if it fails again, ask the user to reconnect.
- 403 → Chift 400 'folder not accessible with this connection' (D7), with the Horus Details appended, because on this endpoint a 403 may also come from user rights (e.g. confirming entries). The Chift contract declares only 400/422/404. No retry.
- 404 → Chift 404.
- 500 or timeout → never blind-retry (D12; Horus has no idempotency key). First run a duplicate check (GET /book-entries.info cannot help, because the Id is lost with the response): book-entries.list Filter.DocumentNo when the number is known; otherwise book-entries.list (DaybookId + period) or account-histories.list (DaybookIds) with Filter.ModifiedAfter=T0, comparing date, accounts and amounts. Retry with exponential backoff only if no match is found.

field_mappings.rule: Identifies the stored Horus licence connection; each licence has its own API base URL. Not sent to Horus.
field_mappings.label: D
field_mappings.evidence: Horus welcome page: "Each fiduciary or SMB using Horus Office has its own database and its own API endpoint."

field_mappings.rule: Chift folder id = Horus Folder.Id (GUID from folders.list). Shared folder rule (D7): folder_id is required whenever the connection has more than one selected folder. If it is null and exactly one folder was selected at activation, use it; if no selection is stored, use the single folder returned by POST /folders.list {Mode: 0}; otherwise return 400 'folder_id required'. A Horus 403 → Chift 400 'folder not accessible with this connection'. A Horus 'folder' is the accounting record of the legal entity whose books are kept. That is the same concept as a Chift folder and is not a Horus 'company', which is a third-party legal entity the folder deals with. The equivalence is deduced from the two descriptions.

field_mappings.evidence: Chift: "A folder represents a legal entity within the system."; FolderId * (required); Guide: Data model "A folder is the accounting record of one company: its configuration, chart of accounts, daybooks and entries. Almost every endpoint requires a FolderId."

field_mappings.horus_source: POST /book-entries.miscellaneous-operations.new → Number (+ AutoGenerateNumber); duplicate pre-check via POST /book-entries.list → Filter.DocumentNo (D12)
field_mappings.rule: Horus semantics [F]: Number is numeric, may be 0 while unconfirmed, and AutoGenerateNumber works only with Confirmed=true (Number left at 0). Connector rule [D]: convert string to number. Reject non-numeric values, and values that do not round-trip (leading zeros, more than 15 digits), with 400/422. If null: Number=0; when Confirmed=true is actually sent (status=posted and the 'always push unconfirmed' setting off, D12), also send AutoGenerateNumber=true and read DocumentNo back. If given: Number=value, AutoGenerateNumber=false, and before creating run the D12 duplicate pre-check: POST /book-entries.list {FolderId, DaybookId, fiscal-year period from fiscal-years.list, Filter.DocumentNo=value}, exact client-side compare, 400 on a match. Treating daybook + fiscal year as the uniqueness scope is an assumption [A]. Uniqueness and format (the example 201909001 looks like YYYYMM + sequence) are not documented.
field_mappings.label: D
field_mappings.evidence: Number *: number [example=201909001] "The number of the miscellaneous operation, which will also be associated to the book entry (can be 0 if not confirmed)"; AutoGenerateNumber: "Only works if "Confirmed" is set to *true*. In that case, the "Number" value will be ignored and should be left at 0."; POST /book-entries.list → Filter.DocumentNo: number [example=1904001]

field_mappings.horus_source: none on misc-op endpoints (CurrencyCode exists only on invoices.*.new/update)
field_mappings.rule: Validate only: accept 'EUR' and reject anything else with 400 ('Horus miscellaneous operations support only EUR'). Nothing is sent. The folder base currency cannot be read, because folders.info has no currency field.

field_mappings.evidence: The misc-op .new schema has no currency field. CurrencyCode appears on invoices.sales.new etc. as "*NULL* by default (= EUR). The folder must be configured to allow currencies for using this field."; POST /account-histories.list → CurrencyCode: "*NULL* means EURO (€) was used."

field_mappings.rule: Accept null or 1 and reject any other value. A rate is meaningful only for a foreign currency, which Horus ODs cannot carry.
field_mappings.label: D
field_mappings.evidence: No CurrencyRate in POST /book-entries.miscellaneous-operations.new; CurrencyRate exists only on invoice endpoints ("Nullable, rate of the day will be used by default").

field_mappings.rule: YYYY-MM-DD → 'YYYY-MM-DDT00:00:00+00:00'. Optional pre-check with fiscal-years.list (Filter.Dates + IncludeFuture=true): a fiscal year contains the date, and the date is strictly after LastMiscOperationsClosureDate (comparison rule D, field format undocumented). fiscal-years.info gives IsClosed=false.

field_mappings.evidence: Date *: string(date-time) [example="2019-09-04T00:00:00+00:00"]; Guide: Making requests "Dates are exchanged as ISO 8601 strings with a time zone offset"

field_mappings.rule: Chift journal id = Horus Daybook.Id. When given: verify Data.Folder.Id == FolderId (D13) and Type == 600 (MiscOperation), otherwise return 400. Type 610/690/700 daybooks are listed by Get journals as miscellaneous_operation with blocked=true (D6, A) and are rejected the same way. When null: daybooks.list Filter.Types=[600]. Exactly one result → use it; otherwise error (Chift contract). If a wages daybook (IsWages, also Type 600) also exists, auto-selection will usually fail. Only Type 600 is auto-selected and validated, which matches the blocked flag of Get journals (D6).
field_mappings.label: F
field_mappings.evidence: DaybookId *; Guide: Data model "A daybook is an accounting journal" / "The daybook Type drives which endpoint you use to post entries" (600 → book-entries.miscellaneous-operations.new); POST /daybooks.list → Types "`600`: MiscOperation"; GET /daybooks.info → Data.Folder.Id

field_mappings.horus_source: POST /book-entries.miscellaneous-operations.new → Confirmed (+ AutoGenerateNumber); per-consumer setting 'always push unconfirmed' (D12)
field_mappings.rule: draft → Confirmed=false. posted (the Chift default) → Confirmed=true, unless the per-consumer setting 'always push unconfirmed' is on (recommended where the accountant must review API entries); then Confirmed=false (D12). Both behaviours are possible in Horus, since Confirmed is a writable flag. Trap: Horus defaults to unconfirmed so that the accountant can review, and confirmed entries cannot be deleted through the API. Which default fits fiduciary clients is an open product decision (D12). Whether every licence or user type, for example entrepreneurs, can confirm entries is undocumented; a 403 is possible.
field_mappings.label: D
field_mappings.evidence: Confirmed: "Nullable, *false* by default"; Guide: Data model "Entries pushed through the API are unconfirmed by default ( Confirmed: false ), which lets the accountant review them in Horus Office before confirming them."; book-entries.list ConfirmedOnly "Include only book entries confirmed by the accountant."

field_mappings.rule: One Horus line per Chift line, sorted by line_number. Balance is checked before sending.
field_mappings.label: F
field_mappings.evidence: Lines *: array[object]; "The sum of the debit amount and credit amount must be balanced."

field_mappings.horus_source: none on input (read side: account-histories → OrderNo)
field_mappings.rule: No writable field. Used only to order the Lines array (stable sort; duplicates keep input order). Assumption to validate: Horus stores array order as OrderNo.

field_mappings.evidence: No line-number field in Lines[] of .new; POST /account-histories.list → Data[].OrderNo: number [example=1]

field_mappings.rule: Copy as-is. Maximum length undocumented.

field_mappings.rule: amount > 0 → Credit=amount, Debit=0. amount < 0 → Debit=abs(amount), Credit=0. amount = 0 → both 0 (acceptance undocumented). Both columns are required and must be non-negative. Connector check: sum(amount) == 0, which is equivalent to total Debit == total Credit.

field_mappings.evidence: Chift: "Positive for Credit and negative for Debit."; Horus Debit *: "Non-negative amount"; Credit *: "Non-negative amount"

field_mappings.label: F
field_mappings.evidence: Lines[].Type *: "1 for customer, 2 for supplier, 3 for general"; Guide: Bank, financial & miscellaneous operations table "1 Customer Required / 2 Supplier Required / 3 General account Not used" (CompanyId)

field_mappings.rule: Sent as the account search key [F]. On customer/supplier lines this is expected to be the collective (concentration) account, e.g. 400000/440000, with the third party identified by CompanyId [D]. This reading comes from the guide's Type 1 + 400000 example and the company concentration accounts; Horus behaviour on a mismatch is undocumented. Optional validation with accounts.list: exact SearchKey match, Inactive/IsSummary flagged.
field_mappings.label: F
field_mappings.evidence: Lines[].Account *: "The account's search key"; Guide: Data model "Each account is identified by a unique search key, which is usually the account number" / "its customer and supplier concentration accounts (e.g. 400000 and 440000 )"

field_mappings.rule: Chift client/supplier id = Horus Company.Id (GUID), assuming the clients/suppliers routes expose Company.Id. Required for Type 1/2: if missing, reject with 422. On Type 3 it is not sent ("Not used"). Optional validation with companies.list Filter.Id (IsCustomer/IsSupplier). A Horus 'company' is a third-party legal entity the folder deals with (customer, supplier or beneficiary); the entity whose books are kept is the folder.
field_mappings.label: D
field_mappings.evidence: Lines[].CompanyId: "Required if type = 1 or type = 2"; Guide: Managing customers & suppliers "Invoices and customer/supplier entry lines reference them through CompanyId"; Guide: Data model "Companies are the legal entities a folder deals with: customers, suppliers and beneficiaries"

field_mappings.horus_source: POST /book-entries.miscellaneous-operations.new → Lines[].CostLines[].Amount + Costs[].SchemaSearchKey/Value (via the per-folder analytics cache: cost-schemas.list + cost-sections.list with IncludeInactive=true, D8)
field_mappings.rule: Chift analytic_account = Horus cost-section GUID Id (D8; aligned with Get analytic accounts). Resolve it only from the folder-scoped analytics cache (D8): cost-sections.list (built per List-type schema with Filter.IncludeInactive=true) → SearchKey, Inactive, CostSchema.Id; then cost-schemas.list → schema SearchKey. No per-call cost-sections.info / cost-schemas.info. This also enforces the cross-folder guard (D13), since cost-sections.info takes no FolderId and returns no Folder. Unknown id → 400; Inactive section → 422 (D8). Send CostLines=[{Amount: abs(amount), Costs:[{SchemaSearchKey, Value: section SearchKey}]}]: one cost line carries 100% of the line (Chift allows no distribution), so the D8 largest-remainder rounding is trivially exact. The folder must be WithAnalytics. Leave CostDistributionKey null. Free schemas (CostSectionType 900) are excluded from Chift analytics in v1 (D8): they are not in the cache, so they cannot be addressed.
field_mappings.label: D
field_mappings.evidence: Chift analytic_account: "This is the id of a analytic account - no distribution possible."; CostLines[].Amount *: "The sum of all cost lines' amounts must be equal to the corresponding line's debit/credit amount."; SchemaSearchKey *: "The search key of an existing cost schema."; Value *: "The search key of an existing cost section, linked to this cost schema"; POST /cost-sections.list → Filter.IncludeInactive: "*FALSE* by default", Data[].Inactive; POST /cost-schemas.list → CostSectionType "`100`: List - expected values are cost sections - `900`: Free"

field_mappings.horus_source: POST /book-entries.miscellaneous-operations.new → response Id (also the only input of GET /book-entries.info → Data.Id)
field_mappings.rule: Return the book entry GUID. It is not stable: any API update creates a new book entry with a new Id. The same Id is all that GET /book-entries.info needs for a read-back (no period or daybook).
field_mappings.label: F
field_mappings.evidence: Response 200 → Id; Guide: Responses & errors "Requests that create or update an entity return only its identifier" / "Updating an invoice or an operation ( invoices.*.update , book-entries.*.update ) generates a new book entry."; GET /book-entries.info → param[query] Id *, Data.Id

field_mappings.horus_source: request Number, or read-back GET /book-entries.info?Id= → Data.DocumentNo (alternatives: account-histories.list Filter.BookEntryId → Data[].DocumentNo; book-entries.list → Data[].DocumentNo)
field_mappings.rule: Number to string. When the number was auto-generated, read DocumentNo back with GET /book-entries.info on the Id returned by create (one call, no period or daybook). Return null if the number is 0 (unconfirmed, no number). Leading zeros from the input are not preserved.
field_mappings.label: D
field_mappings.evidence: Number: "which will also be associated to the book entry"; GET /book-entries.info → Data.DocumentNo: number [example=1904001]; Guide: Reading accounting data "Use book-entries.info to get the full detail of one entry."

field_mappings.rule: 'EUR' (the only accepted input).
field_mappings.label: D
field_mappings.evidence: POST /account-histories.list → CurrencyCode: "*NULL* means EURO (€) was used."

field_mappings.label: D
field_mappings.evidence: No rate on misc-op endpoints.

field_mappings.horus_source: echo of request, or GET /book-entries.info → Data.AccountHistories[] (Type/Id references) resolved via POST /account-histories.list (Filter.BookEntryId, IncludeReport:false) or GET /account-histories.info (1 per reference) → OrderNo, AccountSearchKey, Debit, Credit, Comment, AccountType, CompanyDetail.Company.Id, CostDetail.CostLines[].Costs[].CostSection.Id
field_mappings.rule:
Default: echo the validated request lines. Faithful option, rebuilt from account histories:
- book-entries.info gives only line references (Type/Id). Fetch the content with one account-histories.list call (Filter.BookEntryId), check that every reference came back, and fetch missing ones with account-histories.info.
- Exclude IsReport=true lines.
- amount = coalesce(Credit,0) - coalesce(Debit,0), because both are number|null.
- AccountType 100/200/300 → customer_account/supplier_account/general_account.
- OrderNo → line_number (if missing, keep array order).
- Comment → description; AccountSearchKey → account_number; CompanyDetail.Company.Id → partner_id; CostSection.Id → analytic_account.
- D13: rebuild only from a book-entries.info response whose Folder.Id equals FolderId. account-histories.info has no Folder field, so check that its Data.BookEntry.Id equals the created Id.
field_mappings.label: D
field_mappings.evidence: POST /account-histories.list → Filter.BookEntryId: "Filters on a book entry specified by its id."; Filter.IncludeReport: "*TRUE* by default"; Data[].Debit: number|null; Data[].Credit: number|null; Data[].IsReport; AccountType: "`100`: CollectCust / Customer - `200`: CollectSup / Supplier - `300`: General"; GET /book-entries.info → Data.AccountHistories: array[object] {Type: "AccountHistories", Id}, Data.Folder.Id; GET /account-histories.info → param[query] Id *, Data.BookEntry.Id (no Folder field)

field_mappings.horus_source: request Date (or GET /book-entries.info → Data.Date; account-histories.list / book-entries.list → Data[].Date)
field_mappings.rule: date-time → date (YYYY-MM-DD).
field_mappings.label: F
field_mappings.evidence: GET /book-entries.info → Data.Date: string(date-time) [example="2019-04-04T00:00:00+00:00"]; POST /book-entries.list → Data[].Date: string(date-time); POST /account-histories.list → Data[].Date: string(date-time)

field_mappings.horus_source: resolved DaybookId (or GET /book-entries.info → Data.Daybook.Id; book-entries.list → Data[].Daybook.Id)
field_mappings.rule: Return the DaybookId actually used, including an auto-selected one. When a read-back is made, GET /book-entries.info returns Daybook.Id directly and confirms it; account-histories.list exposes only DaybookSearchKey.
field_mappings.label: F
field_mappings.evidence: GET /book-entries.info → Data.Daybook {Type: "Daybooks", Id}; POST /book-entries.list → Data[].Daybook.Id; POST /account-histories.list → Data[].DaybookSearchKey

field_mappings.horus_source: Confirmed value actually sent (or GET /book-entries.info → Data.Confirmed; account-histories.list / book-entries.list → Data[].Confirmed)
field_mappings.rule: Confirmed=false → 'draft'; true → 'posted'. Without a read-back, use the Confirmed value actually sent, so a 'posted' request pushed unconfirmed under the 'always push unconfirmed' setting (D12) returns 'draft'. A new entry cannot be 'matched' because Chift sends no MatchNo. 'cancelled' has no Horus equivalent.
field_mappings.label: D
field_mappings.evidence: GET /book-entries.info → Data.Confirmed: boolean; POST /book-entries.list → Data[].Confirmed: boolean; POST /account-histories.list → Data[].Confirmed: boolean; Chift MiscellaneousOperationStatusOut enum ['cancelled','draft','posted','matched']

horus_required_without_chift_source.how_to_fill: Shared folder rule (D7): if exactly one folder was selected at activation, use it; if no selection is stored, use the single folder returned by POST /folders.list {Mode: 0}; otherwise return 400 'folder_id required'.

horus_required_without_chift_source.how_to_fill: daybooks.list Filter.Types=[600] only (D6: 610/690/700 are blocked journals and are never auto-selected); use it if there is exactly one, otherwise error (Chift contract rule).
horus_required_without_chift_source.label: F

horus_required_without_chift_source.how_to_fill: 0. When Confirmed=true is actually sent (status=posted, setting off), also send AutoGenerateNumber=true and read DocumentNo back (GET /book-entries.info?Id= → DocumentNo). When the per-consumer 'always push unconfirmed' setting forces Confirmed=false (D12), Number stays 0 and no number is returned.
horus_required_without_chift_source.label: F

horus_required_without_chift_source.how_to_fill: Derived from the sign of the Chift amount; the unused column is set to 0.
horus_required_without_chift_source.label: F

horus_required_without_chift_source.how_to_fill: From partner_id. If missing on a customer/supplier line, reject. No default is possible.
horus_required_without_chift_source.label: F

horus_required_without_chift_source.how_to_fill: abs(line amount): one cost line carrying 100% of the line. Chift allows no distribution, so the D8 largest-remainder rule is trivially exact.
horus_required_without_chift_source.label: F

horus_required_without_chift_source.how_to_fill: Lookup in the per-folder analytics cache (D8): cost-sections.list (IncludeInactive=true) by section Id → SearchKey + CostSchema.Id → cost-schemas.list → schema SearchKey. No per-call .info lookups.
horus_required_without_chift_source.label: D

horus_required_without_chift_source.how_to_fill: Computed from status, the per-consumer 'always push unconfirmed' setting (D12) and the presence of operation_number.
horus_required_without_chift_source.label: D

horus_required_without_chift_source.how_to_fill: Left null, because Chift has no vehicle concept. Whether Horus refuses a line on a vehicle-required account without VehicleId is undocumented.
Left null / not sent. No Chift source; the route carries no attachment.
horus_required_without_chift_source.label: F

limitations.description: There is no currency or exchange-rate field on the misc-operation endpoints. Foreign currency exists only on the invoice endpoints, and folders.info exposes no base currency.
limitations.impact: The route is EUR-only. Chift operations in any other currency cannot be posted and must be rejected. currency_exchange_rate is accepted only as 1 or null.
limitations.label: D

limitations.description: Strict balance: the OD must balance, and the misc-op schema has no AllowUnbalanced option (that option exists only on the invoice endpoints).
limitations.impact: The connector must validate sum(amount)==0, with rounding, before calling. Otherwise Horus returns 400.
limitations.label: F

limitations.description: Confirmed (posted) entries cannot be deleted through the API. DELETE works only for non-confirmed entries injected through the API.
limitations.impact: Chift's default status 'posted' maps to Confirmed=true (D12) and makes the operation irreversible through the connector, unless the per-consumer 'always push unconfirmed' setting is on. Corrections need the update endpoint (which returns a new Id) or the accountant.
limitations.label: F

limitations.description: Updates generate a new book entry Id (book-entries.*.update).
limitations.impact: The id returned by this route can become invalid after a later update. Chift must reconcile on daybook + number, not on Id alone.
limitations.label: F

limitations.description: Horus Number is numeric. Auto-generation works only together with Confirmed=true.
limitations.impact: Alphanumeric Chift operation_number values are refused, and numeric strings lose leading zeros. A draft without a number is stored with Number 0, so no operation_number can be returned.
limitations.label: F

limitations.description: Create returns only {Id}. GET /book-entries.info reads the entry back by that Id alone, but returns the lines only as Type/Id references and is not in the guide's list of sideloading endpoints.
limitations.impact: Header read-back (DocumentNo, Confirmed, Date, Daybook.Id) is one extra call with no period or daybook, needed when the number is auto-generated. Full line fidelity costs one more call: account-histories.list (Filter.BookEntryId, mandatory month/year period) or one account-histories.info per line.
limitations.label: F

limitations.description: line_number has no writable Horus field.
limitations.impact: Line order is conveyed only through the order of the array (assumed to become OrderNo).
limitations.label: A

limitations.description: The single Chift analytic_account ('no distribution possible') maps to one cost section in one List-type cost schema. Horus supports up to 8 schemas, distribution keys and Free (type 900) schemas; Free schemas are excluded from Chift analytics in v1 (D8).
limitations.impact: Folders with several Mandatory cost schemas, or with a Mandatory Free schema, cannot be fully served from the Chift input. Whether Horus rejects such lines is undocumented.
limitations.label: D

limitations.description: Partner information is meaningful only on Type 1/2 lines; CompanyId is 'Not used' for Type 3.
limitations.impact: A partner_id sent on a general_account line is dropped.
limitations.label: F

limitations.description: Only daybook Type 600 is documented as the target of this endpoint (D6).
limitations.impact: The connector auto-selects and accepts only Type 600 journals. Get journals lists 610 TemporaryMiscOperation, 690 SystemMiscOperation and 700 CostMiscOperation as miscellaneous_operation but with blocked=true (A), so a journal_id pointing to them is rejected with 400 until Horus confirms they can be posted to.
limitations.label: F

limitations.description: No idempotency key in Horus write endpoints.
limitations.impact: A retry after a timeout can create a duplicate, so the connector never blind-retries (D12). Whenever operation_number is supplied, a book-entries.list Filter.DocumentNo pre-check runs before the create (D12; the daybook + fiscal-year uniqueness scope is an assumption), and the same exact check runs after a timeout. With auto-numbering, detection after a timeout is only heuristic: query entries in the daybook/period with ModifiedAfter = pre-POST timestamp and compare date, accounts and amounts. Concurrent postings by other users can blur the result.
limitations.label: D

limitations.description: Status values 'matched' and 'cancelled' cannot result from this create call.
limitations.impact: The create response is always 'draft' or 'posted'.
limitations.label: D

limitations.description: MiscOperation lines have no beneficiary line type (only 1 customer, 2 supplier, 3 general), although Horus beneficiaries (e.g. employees) are Companies and wages daybooks (IsWages) exist.
limitations.impact: Low impact for Chift, which has no employee line type either. Payroll ODs needing per-employee sub-ledger detail cannot be represented through this route. Whether a beneficiary Company may be referenced by CompanyId on a Type 1/2 line is undocumented.
limitations.label: D

limitations.description: Every create that carries an operation_number needs two extra calls before posting: fiscal-years.list for the fiscal-year period, and a book-entries.list Filter.DocumentNo duplicate pre-check (D12).
limitations.impact: Higher latency and API usage on numbered operations; this is part of why the route is rated workaround (D11). The pre-check assumes Number is unique per daybook and fiscal year, which Horus does not document.
limitations.label: D

edge_cases.case: Lines do not balance (sum of Chift amounts != 0), including floating-point drift
edge_cases.handling: Round to 2 decimals and reject with 422 before calling Horus. Horus would return 400 (Guide: 'unbalanced entry').
edge_cases.label: F

edge_cases.case: customer_account/supplier_account line without partner_id
edge_cases.handling: Reject with 422: Horus CompanyId is "Required if type = 1 or type = 2".
edge_cases.label: F

edge_cases.case: partner_id given on a general_account line
edge_cases.handling: Do not send CompanyId (guide: 'Not used'). Optionally warn that the partner link is lost.
edge_cases.label: F

edge_cases.case: partner_id is a company that is not flagged IsCustomer (Type 1) or IsSupplier (Type 2)
edge_cases.handling: Pre-validate with companies.list and reject or warn. Horus behaviour is undocumented.

edge_cases.case: customer_account/supplier_account line whose account_number differs from the partner's CustomerConcentrationAccount/SupplierConcentrationAccount (or is a P&L/general account)
edge_cases.handling: Optionally pre-validate: companies.list → concentration account Id → SearchKey via cached accounts.list (or GET /accounts.info, accepted only if Data.Folder.Id = FolderId, D13); then warn or reject. Ask Horus whether it refuses, accepts or overrides the account.

edge_cases.case: status=posted and operation_number null
edge_cases.handling: Confirmed=true, AutoGenerateNumber=true, Number=0. Read DocumentNo back via GET /book-entries.info?Id=<returned Id>, accepted only if Data.Folder.Id = FolderId (D13).
edge_cases.label: F

edge_cases.case: status=draft and operation_number null
edge_cases.handling: Confirmed=false, Number=0. Response operation_number=null.
edge_cases.label: F

edge_cases.case: operation_number is non-numeric (e.g. 'OD-2024-001')
edge_cases.handling: Reject with 400/422 (Number is a number type). Do not silently fall back to auto-numbering.
edge_cases.label: D

edge_cases.case: operation_number with leading zeros ('000123') or a very long digit string
edge_cases.handling: Numeric conversion drops leading zeros ('000123' → 123), and more than 15 digits risks precision loss in JSON numbers. Either reject values that do not round-trip, or accept them and return the Horus value (string of Number), documenting the normalisation.
edge_cases.label: D

edge_cases.case: journal_id null and several Type 600 daybooks (e.g. a general OD daybook plus a wages daybook, IsWages=true)
edge_cases.handling: Return an error as the Chift contract requires. Only Type 600 daybooks are counted (D6), so blocked 610/690/700 journals never make auto-selection fail. Optionally offer a connector setting for a default daybook.
edge_cases.label: F

edge_cases.case: journal_id points to a non-600 daybook (sales, bank, or a 610/690/700 misc daybook)
edge_cases.handling: Reject with 400 after daybooks.info/daybooks.list validation. This includes 610/690/700 daybooks, which Get journals shows as miscellaneous_operation with blocked=true (D6; A until Horus confirms whether they accept this endpoint).
edge_cases.label: D

edge_cases.case: currency != EUR or currency_exchange_rate != 1
edge_cases.handling: Reject with 400 'currency not supported for Horus miscellaneous operations'.
edge_cases.label: D

edge_cases.case: operation_date in a closed period (on or before LastMiscOperationsClosureDate, or fiscal year IsClosed)
edge_cases.handling: Pre-check with fiscal-years.list/info and reject. 'Strictly after the closure date' is a deduction (the closure date is taken as the last closed day). LastMiscOperationsClosureDate is an untyped string|null, so parse it defensively. Horus's own error in this case is undocumented.
edge_cases.label: D

edge_cases.case: operation_date in a fiscal year that fiscal-years.list hides by default (a 'future' year, e.g. early postings into next year's exercise)
edge_cases.handling: Always send Filter.IncludeFuture=true in the pre-check. Do not reject just because the default list is empty.
edge_cases.label: D

edge_cases.case: No fiscal year contains operation_date even with IncludeFuture=true
edge_cases.handling: Reject or warn, according to Chift policy. Horus's own behaviour and error are undocumented. If the operation is not rejected and operation_number is supplied, the D12 pre-check has no fiscal-year period: use the calendar year of operation_date (A).

edge_cases.case: analytic_account given but folder WithAnalytics=false, or the id is not in the folder's analytics cache (unknown, a section of another folder, or not a List-type section)
edge_cases.handling: Reject with 400. Ids are resolved only from the folder-scoped cache (D8), so a section of another folder is 'not found' (D13). For WithAnalytics=false, dropping the analytic link with a warning remains an option if Chift prefers leniency.
edge_cases.label: D

edge_cases.case: analytic_account resolves to an Inactive cost section
edge_cases.handling: Reject with 422 (D8). Inactive is read from the cache built with cost-sections.list IncludeInactive=true (the default FALSE would make it look 'unknown'). Whether Horus itself would accept the section is undocumented, but the connector rejects first.
edge_cases.label: D

edge_cases.case: Folder has additional Mandatory cost schemas beyond the one implied by analytic_account
edge_cases.handling: Unknown whether Horus rejects the line. Pre-detect via the cached cost-schemas.list (Mandatory, D8), warn, and flag it to Horus.

edge_cases.case: Line with amount = 0
edge_cases.handling: Send Debit=0, Credit=0 (acceptance undocumented), or drop the line after agreement with Chift.

edge_cases.case: Account requires a vehicle (car expenses) but Chift provides none
edge_cases.handling: Send without VehicleId. Whether Horus refuses is undocumented.

edge_cases.case: Unknown account_number
edge_cases.handling: Pre-validate with accounts.list, using an exact SearchKey match because the filter is starts-with. Otherwise Horus returns 400 (Guide: Responses & errors 'unknown account').

edge_cases.case: account_number resolves to an account with Inactive=true or IsSummary=true
edge_cases.handling: Pre-validate with the cached accounts.list and reject or warn. Confirm the posting rule with Horus.

edge_cases.case: Horus returns 403 (user/integrator not allowed, e.g. no access to the folder, or an entrepreneur connection trying to post or confirm)
edge_cases.handling: Do not retry. Return Chift 400 'folder not accessible with this connection' (D7; the Chift contract declares no 403), appending the Horus Details because a 403 here may also come from user rights. Use ErrorType for classification. The exact causes of a 403 on this endpoint are undocumented.
edge_cases.label: D

edge_cases.case: Timeout or 500 after POST (the entry may have been created)
edge_cases.handling: Never blind-retry (D12). Before retrying: with a known number, search book-entries.list Filter.DocumentNo. With auto-numbering, query book-entries.list (DaybookId + period) or account-histories.list (DaybookIds) with Filter.ModifiedAfter = timestamp recorded just before the POST, and compare date, accounts and amounts. This is a heuristic, because concurrent postings by others are possible. GET /book-entries.info cannot help here, because the Id is lost with the response.
edge_cases.label: D

edge_cases.case: Line read-back period: account-histories.list filters by month/year, and the accounting month may differ from the calendar month of Date
edge_cases.handling: The header read-back (GET /book-entries.info) needs no period. For lines, use the month of operation_date. If the Id is not found or references are missing, read AccountingMonth/AccountingYear from GET /account-histories.info on one AccountHistories reference and repeat with that exact period, or resolve each reference with account-histories.info.
edge_cases.label: D

edge_cases.case: Duplicate or missing line_number values (default 1 on every line)
edge_cases.handling: A stable sort keeps input order.
edge_cases.label: D

edge_cases.case: operation_number already exists in the target daybook within the fiscal year (D12 pre-check match)
edge_cases.handling: Reject with 400 'operation_number already exists in this journal and fiscal year' before creating, with the existing book entry Id in the message. Treating daybook + fiscal year as the uniqueness scope is an assumption; Horus does not document Number uniqueness.
edge_cases.label: A

edge_cases.case: status=posted while the per-consumer 'always push unconfirmed' setting is on
edge_cases.handling: Send Confirmed=false (D12). AutoGenerateNumber cannot be used ("Only works if "Confirmed" is set to *true*"), so without operation_number Number=0 and operation_number is returned null. Return status 'draft' so the response reflects what Horus stored.
edge_cases.label: D

edge_cases.handling: journal_id: daybooks.info Data.Folder.Id ≠ FolderId → 400 (D13). partner_id: companies.list is folder-scoped by FolderId; if companies.info is used, Data.Folder.Id ≠ FolderId → 400 (D13). Without pre-validation, Horus's behaviour for a CompanyId of another folder is undocumented.

edge_cases.handling: Free schemas are excluded from Chift analytics in v1 (D8), so no value can be sent for them. Warn. Whether Horus rejects the line is undocumented.

open_questions.question: Can every integration or licence set Confirmed=true, or can the fiduciary restrict this? Can a connection authorised by an entrepreneur (IsAccountant=false) post and confirm miscellaneous operations, or will Horus return 403? Does confirmation also lock edits through .update and .lines.update?

open_questions.why: Chift sends one analytic_account per line; we need to know when Horus will reject. Free schemas are excluded from Chift analytics in v1 (D8) until this is answered.

open_questions.why: Chift sends account_number freely; these rules drive pre-validation and error mapping.

open_questions.why: Needed for pre-validation and for mapping errors to Chift 400/422.

open_questions.question: What is the format of LastMiscOperationsClosureDate, and is posting on that exact date allowed? Which fiscal years count as 'future' for IncludeFuture?
open_questions.why: Needed for an exact closed-period and fiscal-year pre-check.

open_questions.why: Chift requires 'currency', and operation_number is a free string. Horus supports neither case.

ba_insights:
Terminology map (each meaning taken from the Horus docs):
- Horus Folder = Chift folder: the legal entity whose books are kept.
- Horus Company = a third-party legal entity the folder deals with (customer, supplier or beneficiary) = Chift partner. The folder's own entity is the Folder.
- Daybook = Chift journal: the posting target, chosen by Type; 600 = MiscOperation.
- Account = ledger account, referenced by its search key.
- Book entry = the operation header (Chift id).
- Account history = one entry line.
- Cost schema = analytic plan; cost section = analytic account.
- MatchNo = matching (lettering) number.

Why more than one call: Horus create endpoints return only an Id (Guide: Responses & errors "Requests that create or update an entity return only its identifier"), while Chift expects the full object back. Horus also references accounts and analytics by search key (Guide: Data model "Accounts and cost schemas/sections are referenced by search key in posting endpoints"), while Chift sends an analytic account id. Hence lookup → create → (conditional) read-back. Reference lookups should be cached per folder (Guide: Reading accounting data "Load it once and cache it per folder").

Read-back by Id: GET /book-entries.info?Id= needs only the Id that create returns (no FolderId, DaybookId or period) and gives DocumentNo, Confirmed, Date, Daybook.Id and the line references. That is the cheapest way to return operation_number after auto-numbering. Lines come back only as references, so full line fidelity needs one account-histories.list call (Filter.BookEntryId) or one account-histories.info per line. book-entries.list is kept for duplicate checks, where the Id is unknown. Accept the read-back only if its Folder.Id matches the request folder (D13).

Sign trap: Chift uses one signed amount (positive = Credit, negative = Debit). Horus uses two non-negative columns, Debit and Credit, which are both mandatory. Horus validates balance ('must be balanced') and, unlike invoices, has no AllowUnbalanced escape hatch on ODs. Validate in the connector to return a clean 422 instead of a Horus 400.

Line-type trap: Horus Type 1/2 lines identify the sub-ledger through CompanyId and, in the guide's example, post on the collective account (400000). Type 3 ignores CompanyId. So Chift 'type' plus 'partner_id' drive two Horus fields, and a partner on a general line is lost. Whether Horus enforces the company's concentration account is undocumented.

Status trap: Chift defaults to 'posted'; Horus defaults to unconfirmed so that the accountant can review. D12 maps posted → Confirmed=true, which is semantically correct, and adds a per-consumer 'always push unconfirmed' setting, recommended where the accountant must review API entries. Confirmed=true removes the API delete option (delete only for "non-confirmed, and have been injected through the API"). With the setting on, AutoGenerateNumber is unavailable, so an unnumbered operation comes back without a number. Which default fits fiduciary clients is a business decision, not a technical detail.

Numbering: Number is numeric and can be 0 while unconfirmed. AutoGenerateNumber works only with Confirmed=true (Number left at 0). A posted operation without a Chift number therefore needs a read-back to return operation_number. A draft without a number has none to return, and leading zeros in a Chift number are lost.

Id stability: every book-entries.*.update returns a new book entry Id and deletes the attachment. Chift-side storage and GET-by-id routes should also reconcile on daybook + DocumentNo (Guide: Reading accounting data).

Currency gap: the Chift contract makes 'currency' required, but Horus ODs have no currency field (unlike invoices). Non-EUR operations must be rejected. Together with numeric-only numbering, this is why the route is rated workaround (D11). State this plainly to clients.

Analytics (D8): Chift analytic_account (a cost-section GUID, 'no distribution possible') becomes one CostLine whose Amount equals the line's debit/credit amount, with Costs = [{SchemaSearchKey, Value}]. Both search keys come from one per-folder cache (cost-schemas.list + cost-sections.list per List-type schema with IncludeInactive=true), never from per-call .info lookups. An inactive section is rejected with 422 and an unknown one with 400. Free (900) schemas are excluded in v1. Multi-dimension or mandatory-schema folders are a known risk to confirm with Horus.

Fiscal-year pre-check: fiscal-years.list hides future fiscal years by default (IncludeFuture FALSE). Always send IncludeFuture=true, or valid postings into next year's exercise will be wrongly rejected.

Error handling (per Guide: Responses & errors), branching on ErrorType ("Use it in your code"):
- 400 → do not retry; surface Details (unknown account, unbalanced entry).
- 401 → refresh the token once.
- 403 → Chift 400 'folder not accessible with this connection' (D7), with the Horus Details; do not retry.
- 500 → back off.
With no idempotency key, never blind-retry (D12): check for an existing entry before any retry after an uncertain POST, exactly via DocumentNo when known, otherwise heuristically via ModifiedAfter.

Verdict calibration (D11): 'supported' means one native endpoint plus cached reference data, deterministic transformations, nothing emulated, and only minor optional fields lost. Create miscellaneous operation has the native endpoint, but it is 'workaround' because non-EUR operations and non-numeric numbers cannot be posted, line_number is not stored, and extra per-request calls are needed (a read-back when Horus numbers the entry; the D12 duplicate pre-check when Chift supplies the number). For clients: 'works natively for EUR ODs with numeric or Horus-generated numbers'.

Journal types (D6): one daybook Type → journal_type table is shared by all routes. 600 → miscellaneous_operation (blocked=false); 610/690/700 → miscellaneous_operation but blocked=true (A, no documented posting endpoint). This route auto-selects and validates only 600, so the 'only one journal' rule counts exactly the journals that Get journals shows as postable.

Cross-folder guard (D13): Horus Id-only endpoints (daybooks.info, companies.info, book-entries.info) take no FolderId, so nothing in the call itself ties the Id to the target folder (D). Always compare Data.Folder.Id with the request's FolderId. For analytics, resolve ids only from the folder-scoped cache, because cost-sections.info returns no Folder.

Duplicate pre-check (D12): whenever Chift supplies operation_number, look it up with book-entries.list Filter.DocumentNo in the target daybook over the fiscal-year period before creating, and never blind-retry after a timeout. Horus has no idempotency key, so this is the only protection available.
